corridor: Oceanside Harbor to Border Field, San Diego County, CA

conventions.coordinate_precision: ~100 m; suitable for station assignment, not navigation

_schema.slug: Stable primary key. Never change after first write; data accumulates against it.
_schema.name: Display name. Safe to change.
_schema.wave.primary: Buoy actually queried today. NDBC WMO id, or null for non-wave sites.
_schema.wave.fallback: Used when primary is not delivering. May be geographically distant; UI must disclose substitution.
_schema.wave.intended_primary: Buoy that SHOULD serve this spot but is currently dead. Reassign here when the REVIVED tripwire fires.
_schema.county_station: State/county beach water quality monitoring station code (e.g. OC-080) from the data.ca.gov Beach Water Quality Monitoring Stations resource. Resolved by nearest-neighbour against Active, located stations only. null = UNRESOLVED, not clean. Must never render as a pass.
_schema.county_station_distance_km: Great-circle km from the spot to its matched station. Over 1 km the match is suspect: the station may sit on a different beach cell with different water. Do not drive a water-quality readout from a suspect match without review.
_schema.audiences: Which audience filters include this spot. Drives column visibility, not thresholds.
_schema.tidepool_floor_ft: Tide height below which the reef is workable. UNCALIBRATED estimates; see tidepool_floor_confidence.
_schema.tidepool_floor_confidence: low = author estimate, needs local verification. verified = confirmed by someone who goes there.
_schema.mpa: Marine protected area NAME from CDFW ds582, resolved by point-in-polygon. null means the point fell outside every MPA polygon. Do not hand-populate. Read together with mpa_resolved: a null with mpa_resolved false is unknown, not unprotected.
_schema.mpa_resolved: true once the CDFW point-in-polygon join has run AND the result survives this file's ~100 m coordinate precision. false where the spot lies within 150 m of an MPA boundary, i.e. inside the coordinate error bar, so the in/out call is not trustworthy either way. Legally load-bearing for the tidepool audience.

46235.name: Imperial Beach Nearshore
46235.note: Station page serves 200 while realtime2 404s. Six south-corridor spots fall back to 46232 across ~15 mi of differing exposure. Reassign on REVIVED.

spots.name: Oceanside Harbor
spots.notes: Harbor mouth; sailing departure point. Watch PZZ740 for small craft advisories.

spots.name: Oceanside Pier
spots.notes: San Luis Rey outfall is just north; USGS 11042000 is the relevant discharge signal after rain.

spots.name: Buccaneer Beach
spots.notes: Loma Alta Creek outlet; chronic dry-weather bacteria site. County station join matters here.

spots.name: Tamarack State Beach
spots.notes: Agua Hedionda lagoon mouth immediately north.

spots.name: Batiquitos Lagoon
spots.notes: No wave binding. Tide still drives mudflat exposure and shorebird foraging; keep tide_station populated.

spots.name: Beacon's Beach
spots.notes: Bluff access; trail condition is a real hazard independent of surf.

spots.name: Moonlight State Beach
spots.notes: Cottonwood Creek outlet; lifeguarded, family default for Encinitas.

spots.name: Swami's
spots.notes: Reef point. Expect Swami's SMCA on resolve; collection restrictions apply.

spots.name: Cardiff Reef
spots.notes: San Elijo lagoon mouth adjacent; post-rain water quality degrades quickly.

spots.name: San Elijo Lagoon
spots.notes: Ecological reserve. High eBird hotspot density.

spots.name: Torrey Pines State Beach
spots.notes: Los Penasquitos lagoon mouth. Long beach; a single point is a poor proxy for its full length.

spots.name: Black's Beach
spots.notes: Scripps submarine canyon focuses swell; this spot breaks materially larger than neighbours on the same buoy reading. Threshold offsets needed.

spots.name: La Jolla Shores
spots.notes: Primary shore-dive entry for the corridor. Dike Rock tidepools at the north end. Expect San Diego-Scripps Coastal SMCA.

spots.name: La Jolla Cove
spots.notes: Expect Matlahuayl SMR: no take of any kind. Pinniped closures apply seasonally and are not in any API.

spots.name: Windansea
spots.notes: Reef break, rock hazard on low tide.

spots.name: Tourmaline Surf Park
spots.notes: Longboard and beginner-friendly; surf threshold should skew lower than neighbours.

spots.name: Mission Beach
spots.notes: Highest general-beachgoer volume in the corridor. Rip current statements matter most here.

spots.name: Ocean Beach Pier
spots.notes: San Diego River mouth immediately north; post-rain plume site.

spots.name: Sunset Cliffs
spots.notes: SAFETY: ledge system with cliff access. Getting the tidepool floor wrong here strands people. Verify before shipping.

spots.name: Cabrillo Tidepools
spots.notes: National Monument: gate hours and entry fee constrain access independently of tide. Expect Cabrillo SMCA. Best-known tidepool site in the corridor.

spots.name: Coronado Central Beach
spots.notes: Increasingly affected by south-county transboundary flows. Least Tern nesting closures seasonally.

spots.name: Silver Strand State Beach
spots.notes: Ocean side uses 9410230. If a bayside spot is added later it must use 9410170; do not reuse this record.

spots.name: Imperial Beach Pier
spots.notes: Most closure-affected spot in the corridor. IBWC station 11013300 is the upstream flow signal, but dry-weather canyon collectors enter downstream of that gauge: a low reading does NOT imply clean water here.

spots.name: Border Field State Park
spots.notes: Tijuana River estuary. Expect Tijuana River Mouth SMCA. Frequently under long-duration closure; water contact audiences should be suppressed, not shown as poor.

unresolved: county_station resolved on all 26 spots by nearest-neighbour against the data.ca.gov monitoring-stations resource (Active + located stations only; the All_SanDiego_County_Beaches and Northern_SanDiego_County_Beaches pseudo-stations were excluded as they are county-wide aggregates, not points). 1 match is over 1 km and is SUSPECT: beacons-leucadia -> EH-420A at 1.402 km (North of cottonwood creek (City of Encin). Beacon's sits in a genuine ~4 km monitoring gap between EH-440 and EH-420A.

mpa point-in-polygon has run against CDFW ds582 for all 26 spots, but 7 are NOT resolved: the spot lies within 150 m of an MPA boundary, which is inside this file's own ~100 m coordinate precision, so the in/out call cannot be trusted. These need surveyed coordinates before the tidepool audience can rely on them: moonlight-encinitas (out of Swami's SMCA by 132 m); swamis (out of Swami's SMCA by 18 m); cardiff-reef (in Swami's SMCA by 29 m); la-jolla-shores (out of Matlahuayl SMR by 45 m); la-jolla-cove (out of Matlahuayl SMR by 21 m); cabrillo-tidepools (in Cabrillo SMR by 11 m); border-field (out of Tijuana River Mouth SMCA by 3 m).

Several spot notes predict an MPA that point-in-polygon contradicts: swamis, la-jolla-shores, la-jolla-cove and border-field all fell OUTSIDE the MPA their note names, each by under 50 m. cabrillo-tidepools is inside Cabrillo SMR, not the SMCA its note names -- an SMR is stricter. Notes are stale, not parsed, and were left untouched; reconcile them when the coordinates are surveyed.
tidepool_floor_ft values are author estimates at confidence 'low'. Sunset Cliffs and Cabrillo are the two that most need local verification.
Per-spot surf threshold offsets are not yet modelled. Black's and Tourmaline are the clearest cases where a shared buoy reading means very different things.
